messages:
Maya: FYI console showed a weird jump: a subset of org-zenpay requests mapped to project:unknown even though keys are project-scoped. Anyone else seeing this?
Jin: saw a few alerts. Are we sure these aren't test tokens hitting prod?
Maya: traced a sample id -> 3c9d7e. headers contain x-project:payments but authn service returned claim project=null.
Arjun: could be the new secret-rotation proxy returning a stale token that misses claim. It unwraps and reissues tokens.
Priya: if proxy omits the project claim during exchange we should still preserve original x-project header as a soft-attribute until authz confirms. Otherwise dashboards show projectless and quotas get weird.
Dan: soft-attribute sounds fine but product wants no silent billing changes. UX asked for an explicit badge: "unverified attribution".
Maya: propose telemetry tag `claim_verification:verified|soft|missing|error`. Add `claim_source` as header|introspect|exchange for easier triage.
Jin: agree. small example we can add to logs: 
```
{req_id: "3c9d7e", claim_verification: "soft", claim_source: "header"}
```
Arjun: router change needed: when exchange service responds 200 but with missing claims, set soft and continue; do NOT change rateband. Instead route to project bucket but mark soft so accounting can reconcile later.
Priya: accounting team will hate that unless we add a reconciliation job that moves soft-attributed tokens to org bucket if they remain unverified after 24h. Also add audit event when reconciliation flips attribution.
Dan: ops: add alert when soft-attribution > 0.5% of traffic for 10m. Also alert on exchange error spikes.
Maya: owners: Jin - telemetry schema; Arjun - router behavior; Priya - reconciliation job + audit; Dan - alerts/runbook. Timeline: telemetry today (4h), router change can be gated (1w), reconciliation job (2w).
infra-bot: ticket ENG-1820 created for telemetry.
Jin: I'll push the schema change and update log-parsers.
Arjun: will prototype router flag `preserve_header_soft=true` behind feature flag.
Priya: I'll sync with accounting now and draft the reconciliation flow.
Maya: thanks. one more UX ask: console should let tenants opt-in to immediate pinning of a soft attribution (with clear legal/billing confirmation) so enterprise customers can avoid noise.
Dan: note: legal sign-off required for explicit pin override. I'll coordinate.
Maya: perfect. closing loop: we'll reconvene after telemetry rollout. :thumbsup:
